cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Hand me the hall key and tell everyone I'm now in charge. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key? My retirement taxi's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The door will understand. The committee needs words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether to cancel Saturday's dance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I decide whether it goes ahead. Then ask me, in front of them. Your taxi can be my first approval.

mechanism: A confidently takes over a hall but accommodates the retiring holder taxi deadline to obtain a public naming of A as the next decision maker.
confusable: Unlike receiving a key or general respect, A needs the outgoing authority to name who decides a concrete upcoming outcome before witnesses.
comparison: Hall dance decision and taxi departure differ from a meeting chair handover and an agenda question.
seedUse: Use D60-a key/retirement taxi/committee dance with S02-b adapting the transfer performance to B needs.
